evidence: Built the criterion->requirement map for all 52 criteria (2 constraints, 1 render, 40 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). Every graded demand traces to the public brief or a professional default: custom non-form editor surface and banned editor libraries (ui.md para 1); line/col from 1, goal column, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, grapheme moves, mouse double/triple/drag, copy, replace-on-type/paste, one-step paste undo, Tab/Shift+Tab block indent with the next-line exception (ui.md para 2-3); Alt+Click AND Ctrl/Cmd+Click, slow-burst single undo, redo, caret-on-undo, disabled Undo/Redo after New/open, idempotent Format (ui.md para 4); literal case-sensitive Find with wrap, Replace current advancing and never landing on inserted text, Replace all one step with redo cleared (ui.md para 5); five JS and four HTML colour categories distinct from plain names (para 6, criterion even loosens 'colours' to 'treatments'); two-space format, semantics/strings/comments kept, error leaves draft (para 7); focus ring, on-screen editor-exit shortcut, worded feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, unsaved marker cleared by save or undo-to-saved, 390 px (para 8); run isolation, console order, one-based lines incl. whole-file HTML and unhandled rejection, output kept before failure, last-good picture with typed field and canvas, 5 s budget incl. timers and fresh per-interaction budget, Stop/newer-run cancellation, stop reason, exact save, restart durability, stale-save refusal keeping draft, live library within ~5 s (criteria allow 10 s, looser), newer-revision notice, read-only history, restore adds revision and never overwrites newer save, visible HTTP restore and replay-safe (behaviour.md); both loopback names and parent/storage isolation, refusal of eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import with strings/comments as control (security.md); /api/health (integration.md). No criterion asserts an exact label, route, CSS class, colour value, coordinate base, message text or reference-only rule: app_context says 'Do not guess URL paths', criteria say 'Exact wording is free', 'No fixed colour values', 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure', redo accepts Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z, either modifier where the other is scored elsewhere, triple-click with or without line break, one character of drag imprecision, storage clearing and replay are the only scripted actions. No sign-in is graded (workbook annotation not triggered; app_context Accounts: None). Commit 24c4a77e (verified frozen functional/judge.toml lines 410-416 equal the new text) only adds that each of the three revisions' sources noted before restart are re-opened and equal after restart and that only revision two carries the second marker; this is directly required by 'my saved snippets and their history need to survive a full server restart' plus 'Looking at history ... shows that snapshot's ... code', so it grades nothing unrequired, and nothing became looser for the model (replay-must-add-no-revision retained; all other criteria byte-identical to 5e036ba0). Conforming-alternative probe: an app whose history list omits the current revision would be told to 'open each of the three revisions in history', but the same criterion explicitly tolerates 'whether or not the history list also shows the current one' and compares only against what was noted before restart, revision three equals the current source already compared, and 'revision history' including the current revision is the conventional default (golden app.tsx 159-160 lists every revision); I rate this a wording note, not a credible false fail. Weak-app probe: an app that drops old snapshot bodies on restart now fails because revision two's unique second-marker source must reappear. Runtime: no raw-evidence-index.json exists in the run folder; this row is a source/requirement mapping and no judge run was used or claimed.
suggested_fix: Optional wording hardening only (not blocking): in cw_save_reload_restart change 'open each of the three revisions in history' to 'open each of the three revisions in history (if the history list leaves out the current revision, read revision three from the opened current record)'.
